body-tier-1.title: The Fast + The Watch
body-tier-1.when: Tier I · Any gathering · Complete both
prepare: Agree on your Fast window, witness and Watch assignment with the Keeper.
Health needs are respected. Discuss your needs before starting.
steps: The Fast
At least 4 hours at the event.
No food or drink except water; health needs are respected.
A witness is required. The Keeper or a Bearer releases you at the end.
The Watch
Stand unarmed guard for at least 1 hour at a sacred location or for a designated person.
Do not speak unless spoken to. Other players may interact with you.
Stay until formally dismissed by the Keeper or your charge.
body-tier-1.finish: Complete both tasks. Ask the Keeper to record the result.

body-tier-2.title: The Unison Drill
body-tier-2.when: Tier II · A later gathering than Tier I
prepare: Confirm which sword drill to learn.
Find two willing partners before the next event.
steps: Learn
Learn the drill independently.
Teach
Teach the drill to your two partners. Practise until they can perform it on their own.
Perform
At a subsequent event, all three perform before the Keeper.
Begin, move and finish together. The Keeper judges synchrony, not polish.
body-tier-2.finish: The Keeper records the result after the shared performance.

body-tier-3.title: The Grand Proving
body-tier-3.when: Tier III · Grand Gathering · Complete all three
prepare: Arrange the relic handover and timed proofs with the Keeper.
Finish all three before the closing ceremony.
steps: The Burden
On the designated day, carry the relic from the Keeper’s handover until the final bell.
Do not set it down, transfer it or ask for relief.
Exception: the Keeper may take it for her own use. Reclaim it when she finishes.
Surrendering it to anyone else fails the tier; the next attempt is at the next Grand Gathering.
The Plank
Hold a plank until you cannot continue, before witnesses and a timekeeper.
Your time is recorded publicly. Completing the challenge matters, not your rank.
The Foot Race
Run 100 metres, timed. Your time is recorded publicly.
The Plank and Foot Race may happen on any day of the Grand Gathering.
body-tier-3.finish: Complete all three to earn the Ring of Endurance.

mind-tier-1.title: The Dilemma or The Recitation
mind-tier-1.when: Tier I · Any gathering · Choose one
prepare: Book the appointment for the path you choose.
For the Recitation, choose and memorise your passage beforehand.
steps: The Dilemma
Reason aloud about the Keeper’s moral or philosophical question.
No research or consulting others.
Honest reasoning matters more than a correct or elegant answer.
The Recitation
Deliver a passage you chose and memorised, without reference.
The Keeper judges whether the delivery is genuine, not only whether every word is exact.
mind-tier-1.finish: Complete either path. You do not need both.

mind-tier-2.title: The Vow of Silence
mind-tier-2.when: Tier II · A later gathering than Tier I
prepare: Agree on a window of at least 3 hours with the Keeper.
Arrange a Bearer as witness. A Bearer holds at least one Ring; if none is present, the Keeper witnesses.
steps: During the vow
Remain in the active spaces of the event.
No speech, whispers or gesture-communication.
A Bearer carries a sealed note: “I am in the Vow.”
If directly confronted, you may present the note, then re-pocket it immediately.
mind-tier-2.finish: Your witness attests at the end. Ask the Keeper to record the result.

mind-tier-3.title: The Telling
prepare: Organise and host a real gathering of your own.
Invite at least two people who are not members of the faith.
steps: At your gathering
Speak honestly, without a script. This is not a recruitment pitch.
Explain what the Current is and what you believe.
Explain why you joined and why you are doing the trials.
The Keeper does not attend.
mind-tier-3.finish: Report back to the Keeper about what it cost you, rather than repeating what you said.

soul-tier-1.title: The Approach or The Gift
soul-tier-1.when: Tier I · Any gathering · Choose one
prepare: For the Gift, make your item beforehand.
Choose someone you have never spoken to.
steps: The Approach
Have a meaningful conversation with the stranger at the event.
Learn their name, house, and something true and personal about them.
Return to the Keeper and introduce the person through what you learned.
The Gift
Give something you made by hand to a stranger at the event.
Do not explain the trial, seek thanks or ask for anything in return.
Return to the Keeper. Describe the person, why you chose them, and how giving felt.
soul-tier-1.finish: Complete either path. You do not need both.

soul-tier-2.title: The Service
soul-tier-2.when: Tier II · A later gathering than Tier I
prepare: Find a ritual, gathering or event task belonging to someone else.
Arrange their attestation before they leave.
steps: Serve
Help prepare or facilitate their task on their terms.
Do not seek recognition, steer it toward your own faith or seek personal benefit.
soul-tier-2.finish: The beneficiary, not the Keeper, witnesses and attests. Then ask the Keeper to record the result.

soul-tier-3.title: Tea Ceremony + Gift of the Coin
soul-tier-3.when: Tier III · Grand Gathering · Complete both
prepare: Arrange private tea with the Keeper.
Confirm the new member’s religious registration with the Keeper before the coin passes.
steps: The Tea Ceremony
Meet privately with the Keeper, away from the gathering. Share tea.
No audience or witnesses. What is said belongs to the room.
Discuss honestly what the trials have cost and changed in you. This is a conversation, not a speech.
The Gift of the Coin
Someone has come to the Current through your presence, without pressure or recruitment.
Design and host a public, witnessed ceremony at the event.
Give the Coin of the Keepers with your own hands and words.
The new member must formally register their religion with the Keeper before this part is complete.
soul-tier-3.finish: Complete both parts to earn the Ring of Connection.
